Note: button_up's required_elements (one_hour_block, phone_appointment_specified, no_driving_at_computer) are written for phone appointments with a closer; this call books an in-person visit, so those specific elements don't directly apply, but the underlying discipline of the is_that_fair handshake to lock a firm next step still does and is missing here.
alternative_hypothesis: A booked read is defensible since a specific day and time were stated ('tomorrow at two'), but the rep's own next sentence walks it back into a pending-confirmation state, which undercuts treating it as fully locked.
coaching_implication: Coach Parker to either get provisional manager approval before the call ends or clearly frame this as a callback ('I'll confirm by text tonight whether tomorrow at 2 works') rather than stating a time and then immediately qualifying it as unconfirmed.
